title: Explicit signed projection from the total cone to a shifted column cone
statement: Let C be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] admitting total complexes of natural-indexed first-quadrant bicomplexes [def-sp-double-complex-total]. For a bicomplex K and natural p,m, horizontalTotalProjection is the coproduct-descending map from Tot(K)^m to K^{p,m-p}, identity (with index transports) on the summand with horizontal index p and zero on all other summands. For integer m, horizontalExtendedProjection maps extend(Tot(K))^m to extend(K^{p,bullet})^{m-p}; it is this projection transported through the extension isomorphisms when m>=p and zero otherwise. For f:A to B, natural p and integer n, coneHorizontalProjection maps Cone(extend(Tot(f)))^n to Cone(extend(f^{p,bullet}))[-p]^n using the cone biproduct decomposition: the source component is (-1)^p times horizontalExtendedProjection A p (n+1), and the target component is horizontalExtendedProjection B p n, followed by the column-cone inclusions with the indicated degree transports.

lean.statement:
def coneHorizontalProjection
    {A B : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (p : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    (CochainComplex.mappingCone
      (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (total.map f (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)).X n ⟶
      ((CochainComplex.mappingCone
        (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (f.f p) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))⟦-(p : ℤ)⟧).X n
